continuation.text:
I left `src/solution.py` unchanged because it already meets the current requirements.

- **Capacity check:** it sums the demand for each resource and returns `False` if any total exceeds capacity. It also returns `False` if a request names a resource that doesn't exist.
- **Leftover check:** it returns `True` only if at least one resource still has capacity left after all requests. If every resource is fully used, it returns `False`.

I ran no checks and made no edits.

I read "at least one resource must remain unallocated" as "at least one resource has spare capacity". An allocation that uses all of every resource is rejected. I also kept the existing `ValueError` for a request that isn't a dictionary, since removing it would be an unrelated change.
